name: Dumbbell Fly
summary: An isolation movement that stretches and contracts the chest through a wide arc with the arms slightly bent.
setup: Lie on a flat bench with a light dumbbell in each hand, feet planted.
Hold the dumbbells above the chest with palms facing each other.
Pull shoulder blades back and down.
Keep a soft, fixed bend in the elbows.
execution: Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc, keeping the elbow bend constant.
Stop when you feel a stretch across the chest, around upper-arm parallel to the floor.
Bring the dumbbells back up in the same arc, as if hugging a barrel.
Finish with the weights over the chest without letting them clank.
mistakes: Going too heavy: use a light load; this is an isolation exercise.
Lowering too deep so the shoulders roll forward: stop at a comfortable stretch.
Straightening and bending the elbows (turning it into a press): keep the angle fixed.
Letting the weights fall quickly: lower for 2-3 seconds.
